description: Identify the 1VM9 reference, repeat the ligand-seeded structural superposition of FdeD against RO-ferredoxin, diiron-BMM and bc1 Rieske folds, and compare Rieske cluster ligand spacing across 21 reviewed small Rieske proteins of known partner class
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def rcsb(p):
    r = requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb", timeout=60); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
def afdb(acc):
    m = requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",
                     headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}, timeout=60).json()[0]
    return requests.get(m["pdbUrl"], headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}, timeout=60).text, m

fded_pdb, afmeta = afdb("D8J0W8")
refs = {p: rcsb(p) for p in ["1FQT","1VM9","1RIE"]}
for p, t in refs.items():
    print(p, "::", " ".join(l[10:].strip() for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith("TITLE")))
print()

AA3 = {'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
       'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
       'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse_ca(t, chain=None):
    nums, seq, xyz, seen = [], [], [], set()
    for line in t.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("ENDMDL") and nums: break
        if not line.startswith("ATOM") or line[12:16].strip() != "CA": continue
        if line[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        ch = line[21]
        if chain is None: chain = ch
        if ch != chain: continue
        rn = line[22:27]
        if rn in seen: continue
        res = line[17:20].strip()
        if res not in AA3: continue
        seen.add(rn); nums.append(int(line[22:26])); seq.append(AA3[res])
        xyz.append([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
    return nums, "".join(seq), np.array(xyz)

LIG = re.compile(r'C(.)H(.{12,32}?)C(..)H')
def ligands(seq, nums):
    m = LIG.search(seq)
    if not m: return None
    c1=m.start(); h1=c1+2; c2=m.start(3)-1; h2=m.start(3)+2
    return dict(idx=[c1,h1,c2,h2], resnum=[nums[c1],nums[h1],nums[c2],nums[h2]],
                motif=seq[c1:h2+1], spacing=nums[c2]-nums[c1])

def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc = P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
    U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc)); d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))
    R = Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
    return R, qc - R@pc
def superpose(mob,fix,sm,sf):
    R,t = kabsch(mob[sm],fix[sf]); pairs=list(zip(sm,sf))
    for cut in [8.,6.,5.,4.,4.,4.]:
        M=(R@mob.T).T+t
        D=np.linalg.norm(M[:,None,:]-fix[None,:,:],axis=2)
        bm,bf=D.argmin(1),D.argmin(0)
        pr=[(i,int(bm[i])) for i in range(len(M)) if D[i,bm[i]]<cut and bf[bm[i]]==i]
        if len(pr)<4: break
        pairs=pr; R,t=kabsch(mob[[a for a,_ in pairs]],fix[[b for _,b in pairs]])
    M=(R@mob.T).T+t; pm=[a for a,_ in pairs]; pf=[b for _,b in pairs]
    return len(pairs), float(np.sqrt(((M[pm]-fix[pf])**2).sum(1).mean())), \
           float(np.sqrt(((M[sm]-fix[sf])**2).sum(1).mean()))

qn,qs,qx = parse_ca(fded_pdb); ql = ligands(qs,qn)
print("FdeD len=%d ligands=%s motif=%s C1->C2=%d meanpLDDT=%.2f"
      % (len(qs), ql["resnum"], ql["motif"], ql["spacing"], afmeta["globalMetricValue"]))
rows=[]
for p,t in refs.items():
    rn,rs,rx = parse_ca(t); rl = ligands(rs,rn)
    n,rmsd,lrm = superpose(qx,rx,np.array(ql["idx"]),np.array(rl["idx"]))
    rows.append(dict(pdb=p,reflen=len(rs),spacing=rl["spacing"],n_eq=n,rmsd=rmsd,lig=lrm,
                     covQ=100*n/len(qs),covR=100*n/len(rs)))
    print(f"{p}: reflen={len(rs):3d} spacing={rl['spacing']:2d} equivCA={n:3d} RMSD={rmsd:.2f}A "
          f"ligandCA={lrm:.2f}A cov(FdeD)={100*n/len(qs):.0f}% cov(ref)={100*n/len(rs):.0f}%")
D = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\nspread of RMSD across the three classes: %.2f A (min %.2f, max %.2f)"
      % (D.rmsd.max()-D.rmsd.min(), D.rmsd.min(), D.rmsd.max()))

CLASS = {'BPHA3_RHOJR':'RO ferredoxin','TECA3_CUPXP':'RO ferredoxin','CMTAD_PSEPU':'RO ferredoxin',
 'ANDAB_BURCE':'RO ferredoxin','HCAC_ECOLI':'RO ferredoxin','BNZC_PSEPU':'RO ferredoxin',
 'TODB_PSEPU':'RO ferredoxin','NAGAB_RALSP':'RO ferredoxin','NDOA_PSEPU':'RO ferredoxin',
 'BEDB_PSEPU':'RO ferredoxin','DNTAB_BURSR':'RO ferredoxin','CARAC_METRE':'RO ferredoxin',
 'BPHA3_PSES1':'RO ferredoxin','BPHF_PARXL':'RO ferredoxin','TMOC_ECTME':'diiron BMM',
 'XAMOC_XANVE':'diiron BMM','MSMC_METHY':'diiron BMM','QCRA_BACSU':'bc1/b6f','PRP_SYNY3':'bc1/b6f',
 'NASE_BACSU':'other','SDX_SULTO':'other'}
q = "(" + " OR ".join(f"id:{k}" for k in CLASS) + ")"
res = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params=dict(query=q, fields="id,sequence,length", format="json", size=100), timeout=120).json()
sp=[]
for e in res["results"]:
    nm=e.get("uniProtkbId",""); s=(e.get("sequence") or {}).get("value","")
    if not s or nm not in CLASS: continue
    l=ligands(s,list(range(1,len(s)+1)))
    sp.append(dict(name=nm,cls=CLASS[nm],length=len(s),
                   spacing=(l["spacing"] if l else np.nan),motif=(l["motif"] if l else "")))
S=pd.DataFrame(sp).sort_values(["cls","spacing"])
print("\n", S[["name","cls","length","spacing","motif"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nFdeD: length=112 spacing=%d" % ql["spacing"])
print(S.groupby("cls")["spacing"].agg(["count","min","median","max"]).to_string())
ro = S[S.cls=="RO ferredoxin"]["spacing"].dropna()
print("\nRO-ferredoxin spacing values:", sorted(ro.astype(int)))
print("FdeD spacing %d exceeds the RO-ferredoxin maximum (%d): %s"
      % (ql["spacing"], ro.max(), ql["spacing"] > ro.max()))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13.2,4.7))
cols={'RO ferredoxin':'#1f77b4','diiron BMM':'#d62728','bc1/b6f':'#2ca02c','other':'#7f7f7f'}
rng=np.random.RandomState(0)
for i,c in enumerate(cols):
    sub=S[S.cls==c]
    ax[0].scatter(sub["spacing"], i+rng.uniform(-.13,.13,len(sub)), s=60, color=cols[c], zorder=3)
ax[0].axvline(ql["spacing"], color='k', ls='--', lw=1.7)
ax[0].text(ql["spacing"]+0.4, 3.3, "FdeD = %d" % ql["spacing"], fontsize=10)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(4)); ax[0].set_yticklabels(list(cols))
ax[0].set_xlabel("residues between the two cluster cysteines (C1 to C2)")
ax[0].set_title("Rieske ligand spacing in proteins with an assigned partner", fontsize=11)
ax[0].grid(axis='x', alpha=.3)
lab={'1FQT':'1FQT BphF\nRO ferredoxin','1VM9':'1VM9 T4moC\ndiiron BMM','1RIE':'1RIE bovine ISP\nbc1 Rieske'}
b=ax[1].bar([lab.get(p,p) for p in D["pdb"]], D["rmsd"],
            color=[cols['RO ferredoxin'],cols['diiron BMM'],cols['bc1/b6f']])
for r_,n_,cq in zip(b,D["n_eq"],D["covQ"]):
    ax[1].text(r_.get_x()+r_.get_width()/2, r_.get_height()+.03, f"{n_} CA ({cq:.0f}%)", ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylim(0,2.2); ax[1].set_ylabel("CA RMSD over equivalent atoms (A)")
ax[1].set_title("FdeD AlphaFold model superposed on three Rieske folds", fontsize=11)
ax[1].grid(axis='y', alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
